text: No state shareholder found. Sustained regulatory record: OKX's operating entity Aux Cayes FinTech Co. Ltd pleaded guilty in the US (SDNY) to violating anti-money laundering law and agreed to penalties totalling more than $500m.

source.name: US Department of Justice, SDNY press release
source.quote: OKX agreed to pay monetary penalties totaling more than $504 million.

additionalSources.name: Cointelegraph, ‘OKX pleads guilty, pays $505M to settle DOJ charges’ by Brayden Lindrea
additionalSources.quote: OKX's Aux Cayes FinTech Co. Ltd agreed to pay over $500 million worth of fines for operating an unlicensed money-transmitting business.
